purpose: Turn noisy browser-surface findings into explicit, fail-closed trust decisions. Reviewed DOM sinks are accepted only while the exact Git blob remains unchanged; mutable third-party scripts remain monitored as external trust dependencies rather than being incorrectly pinned with brittle SRI.

externalScripts.rationale: Umami's official documentation explicitly supports proxying or self-hosting the tracker and warns that a hosted copy must be refreshed when the tracker changes. Because cloud.umami.is/script.js is an unversioned mutable asset, static SRI would create a brittle availability dependency. The Holding instead keeps the exact vendor URL allowlisted, monitors the remote bytes, and reopens review whenever the remote hash changes or the review window expires.

reviewedDomInnerHtml.rationale: The only user-controlled value is coerced through Number() before rendering; labels, styles and scenario strings are static constants.

Reviewed sinks render static registry/i18n structures and same-origin canonical Company, Stable, Rewards, Reporting, Economic Graph and protocol-lifecycle artifacts. External/string fields in the reviewed render paths are escaped and numeric fields are formatted/coerced before insertion; no URL/search/form/user string is routed directly into these assignments. Any file change invalidates this review and reopens every sink automatically.
